scope: Sectional review of one consumer workflow. References assign intended obligations, not product completion or exhaustive document review.

additional_requirements.heading: Inputs, revisions and extents
additional_requirements.statement: Declare the acquired representation and known coverage: a byte window or logical row export does not claim a full physical input; unavailable contributing evidence remains explicit.
additional_requirements.why_distinct: Existing byte-retention, snapshot and record-counting laws do not independently identify whether acquired evidence claims a full physical input or only an export/window with unknown coverage.

additional_requirements.heading: 2. Material
additional_requirements.statement: Declare the acquired representation and known coverage: a byte window or logical row export does not claim a full physical input; unavailable contributing evidence remains explicit.
additional_requirements.why_distinct: Existing byte-retention, snapshot and record-counting laws do not independently identify whether acquired evidence claims a full physical input or only an export/window with unknown coverage.

additional_requirements.heading: Rules
additional_requirements.statement: Initial interpretation, ingress retries and replay resolve registered immutable bytes; changing or removing the acquisition URI never substitutes current provider content.
additional_requirements.why_distinct: Replay/readback laws do not independently identify first ingress reopening a mutable acquisition URI after immutable registration.

obligations.heading: Inputs, revisions and extents
obligations.acceptance: Capture a full file then an append window; distinguish a logical export from a page snapshot and leave an unknown prefix explicit.

obligations.heading: 2. Material
obligations.acceptance: Capture rows and a consistent snapshot; retained row exports do not claim unexported database columns or unknown capture intervals.

obligations.heading: Inputs, revisions and extents
obligations.acceptance: Retry the same capture without new identity; equal append bytes at different logical windows retain their correct coordinates.

obligations.heading: 6. Identity and occurrences
obligations.acceptance: Replay keeps occurrence anchors; equal bytes from distinct captured occurrences remain distinct where the source declares no equivalence key.

obligations.heading: Blobs
obligations.acceptance: Delete or mutate the provider path after retention and read the original captured bytes with their recorded hash.

obligations.heading: Rules
obligations.acceptance: Remove or mutate the acquisition URI before initial ingress; the registered stored bytes remain authoritative and missing blobs fail explicitly.

obligations.heading: Inputs, revisions and extents
obligations.acceptance: Reconstruct the full revision from earlier extents and delta bases, retaining companion and attachment references; a missing root is not replaced from the live path.

obligations.heading: Roles a material can play
obligations.acceptance: Reassemble retained parts and snapshot bases/patches; missing required predecessors or attachments produce the source-declared incomplete/error outcome.

obligations.heading: The same conversation through several routes
obligations.acceptance: Compare source-derived expected messages with normalized output; account for every framed record and preserve contribution references through lossy rewrites.

obligations.heading: 3. Event
obligations.acceptance: Compare expected event meaning, provenance and time quality with source bytes; unknown clocks and omitted fields are not invented.

obligations.heading: Parse
obligations.acceptance: Interrupt between row commits and checkpoint/terminal reply; retry the same intent without duplicate rows or a fabricated completed result.

obligations.heading: 6. NATS JetStream and KV
obligations.acceptance: Lose the final reply after durable admission; verify stored content, terminal acknowledgement and confirmed-consumer progress separately across retry.

obligations.heading: Results
obligations.acceptance: Read/search/export through packaged clients; incomplete evidence is degraded or unavailable, and optional backend parity is evaluated on a fixed producer/consumer pair.

obligations.heading: What Sinex hands back to Polylogue
obligations.acceptance: Compare the actual client answer with independent retained-input facts and a fresh read-model rebuild; direct bus/codec checks do not close the joined route.

obligations.heading: Crash safety without repair
obligations.acceptance: Kill at actual retention/index/publication boundaries and restart the same state; final bytes, rows and answer equal an uninterrupted baseline.

obligations.heading: 6. NATS JetStream and KV
obligations.acceptance: Restart after retained ingress and an unsettled confirmed delivery; the same immutable evidence redelivers without loss or duplicate live meaning.
